synopsis: The Integrated Decision Support Key (IDSK) links each decision to an evaluation question and then to the data required to answer it; Chapter 12 and the glossary consistently describe this logic [f9550, f16409, f9813]. The glossary identifies IDSK as the core device of a Test and Evaluation Master Plan (TEMP), while Chapter 12 recommends it as the virtual-validation programme’s roadmap-to-evidence link [f16409, f9550]. For presenting the plan, Chapter 12 recommends a 2–6-page evidence, V&V and test strategy section, using IDSK and TEMP alongside NASA-STD-7009B and NATM as templates or sources [f10162]. These facts establish a recommended planning structure, but do not report results demonstrating its effectiveness [f9550, f16409, f9813, f10162].

relations.note: Both describe TEMP’s IDSK logic linking decisions, evaluation questions and required data.
Both state IDSK’s decision, evaluation question and data linkage.
IDSK’s core TEMP role supports its recommendation as the roadmap-to-evidence link.
